chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as addressing both humans and jinn, highlighting the dual nature of creation's gratitude. The repetition underscores the infinite scope of divine favors, inviting reflection on both physical and spiritual blessings. It serves as a reminder of accountability, urging believers to acknowledge Allah's mercy in every aspect of existence.
